title: OCPE evidence statement
description: A lightweight, self-contained evidence statement that can be attached to any OCPE assertion (entity, relationship, range, model element). It records WHAT is supported, BY WHICH references, at WHAT strength, and is independent of any review or approval workflow: those are downstream organizational concerns, not part of the OCPE language. Structural validity of an evidence statement says nothing about its scientific correctness.

claim.description: The specific proposition this evidence supports.

supports.description: Which aspect of the assertion the evidence supports. Direction-level support must not be read as magnitude-level support.

citation.description: Human-readable citation text, preserved verbatim from source where available.

basis.description: Nature of the evidential basis. 'definitional' is used for mathematical identities (e.g. mean = sum/n) that need no empirical citation.
